verdict.rationale: The public business entity database ("Search Corporations and Business Entities") shows whether an entity is active or inactive, along with its organization date and jurisdiction. There is also a public license-record search, and online filers get an emailed acknowledgement and receipt. Together these let a founder confirm a completed filing from public pages, but nothing shows a way to track a pending filing, application, or case while it is in progress. Missing for 10: a public status tracker for submitted or pending filings and applications, case/complaint status lookup, documentation of when filings appear in the database, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
